transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve been getting really overwhelmed since I tried to make my art into an actual freelance business. It’s like invoices or client messages just wind me up, and then I put them off until I’m crying at the kitchen table. I’m even forgetting normal things, like paying a bill, and it’s starting to feel like I’m not handling it very well.
Do you find yourself having repetitive thoughts that you can't stop thinking about?
I don’t think so. I mean, I do worry about things, but it doesn’t feel like a thought playing over and over that I can’t stop. It’s more just stress about what needs to get done.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge when you're not working on your art or business tasks?

Mostly it’s tied to the business stuff. Like, if I know there’s an invoice I haven’t sent or a client message waiting, I get really wound up even if I’m not actually working on it. Then I avoid it, and it builds until I’m upset or I mess up other normal things, like forgetting to pay a bill.
Do you ever feel like you have to perform specific rituals or behaviors to relieve your anxiety or stress?
No, I don’t think so. I don’t have any rituals or specific things I feel like I have to do to make the anxiety go away. It’s more that I get stressed and avoid things.
Is your anxiety limited to just your business and art tasks, or do you feel anxious about other areas of your life as well?

It’s mostly the business and art stuff. Since I tried to make my art into an actual freelance business, I get really wound up about invoices or client messages, and then I avoid them. It builds up until I’m crying at the kitchen table or I forget regular things, like paying a bill.
Are you having trouble sleeping or experiencing changes in your appetite due to your stress about the business?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a big change with sleep or appetite specifically. The stress is there, but I can’t say it’s clearly affecting those things.
Is there something specific about the business or art tasks that scares you or makes you anxious?

I think it’s the “real business” parts that scare me more than the art itself. Like invoices, client messages, anything where I feel like I have to be professional and not mess it up. I get really wound up about it, then I avoid it, and it piles up until I’m overwhelmed.
Do you feel like you need to do everything perfectly in your business, and that making a mistake would be unacceptable?

I don’t know if I’d say it has to be perfect exactly. I do worry about messing things up, but I’m not sure I think a mistake would be totally unacceptable. It’s more like I get nervous and stuck when I think I might do it wrong.
Do you often criticize yourself for not handling your business tasks as well as you think you should?

I’m not sure. I do get frustrated with myself when I put things off, but I haven’t really thought of it as criticizing myself all the time. It’s more like, “Why can’t I just do this?” and then I feel stuck.
Do you worry about things outside of your business and art, like your health, relationships, or everyday situations?

Not really, no. I mean, I have normal worries sometimes, but I haven’t noticed the same kind of anxiety with health or relationships or everyday stuff. It mostly seems tied to the business side of things.
Has your anxiety about the business side of your art affected your relationships with friends or family?
I’m not really sure that it has. I mean, I might be a little distracted or frustrated sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it causing real problems with my friends or family.
Has your anxiety about the business side of your art made it difficult for you to function in your daily life or achieve your goals?

Yes, a bit. It’s starting to get in the way of things. I put off replying to a client because I was so caught up and anxious about the art display, and I also missed a utility payment at home. It’s not totally out of control, but it is affecting my freelance work and some home responsibilities.
Is your anxiety more about the outcome of your business tasks or the process of completing them?

It’s more the business side of finishing things, I think. Like invoices, client messages, setting up displays—those tasks make me feel wound up, and then I avoid them. Then it builds until I’m upset at my kitchen table or I forget normal things, like paying a bill.
Do you think your anxiety about the business side of your art is mostly because you're afraid of making mistakes?

I’m not sure it’s mostly that. I mean, I don’t want to mess things up, but I haven’t really thought of it as just fear of mistakes. It feels more like the whole business part makes me tense and I end up avoiding it.
Do you feel anxious when you're not thinking about your business or art tasks?

Not usually, no. It’s mostly when I’m thinking about the freelance art stuff—the invoices, client messages, setting up displays. That’s when I get wound up and then start avoiding it. If I’m not thinking about that, I’m generally not anxious in the same way.
Is there a particular business task that triggers your anxiety more than others?

Probably invoices and client messages. Those are the ones that make me feel the most wound up, and then I put them off. It gets to the point where I’m sitting at my kitchen table crying because I’ve let it build up.
Is your anxiety about the business side of your art more related to the organizational aspects or the fear of not meeting others' expectations?

I think it’s more the organizational side, honestly. Once I tried to make my art into a real freelance business, things like invoices and client messages started feeling really overwhelming. I put them off, and then it builds until I’m crying at the kitchen table or forgetting regular things, like paying a bill.
Do you worry about being evaluated or judged by others in areas of your life outside of your freelance business?
I’m not sure I’ve really noticed that outside of the freelance stuff. I don’t think I spend much time worrying about being judged in general, no. It’s more tied to the business side when it comes up.
Is your anxiety about the business side of your art focused on the tasks themselves or the consequences of not completing them?

It’s kind of both, but I think it starts with the tasks themselves. The invoices and client messages feel overwhelming, so I avoid them. Then once I’ve put them off, I get more upset about what’s going to happen because I haven’t done them, and it can build up until I’m crying at the kitchen table or forgetting regular things like paying a bill.
Do you think making a mistake in your business tasks is what's primarily causing your anxiety?

Not really, no. I don’t think it’s mainly about making a mistake. It’s more that the business tasks themselves—like invoices and client messages—make me feel wound up, and then I avoid them. Then it piles up until I’m really upset, like crying at the kitchen table or forgetting normal things like paying a bill.
